subject: ONE live-evidence re-mint after today's last manifest move (v97 aa9ce381, PR #1504)
body: ONE re-mint of the live evidence is owed after today's last manifest move. PR #1504 (the emitter-discipline hand-mutant pins; proof 139 → 150) regenerated artifacts/sync/live-sync-manifest.json from v96 3c69fedd to v97 aa9ce381438ecb26 and has now landed on SignalGrid_Alpha at 2b7f81f342b63cc5bb2e9850b3509cdcc9361b56; no other PR in today's batch moved the manifest (#1534, the mutation-sweep sharding gate, leaves it at the same version). The Mac's evidence artifacts/live-evidence/mac-run.json carries mintedAt 2026-10-15T16:33:53.511Z for fingerprint 3c69fedd, so `node scripts/check-readiness-figure.mjs` reads dimension (b) 0% and HEADLINE 0% (OUTREACH CLOSED) on the tip until the re-mint — by design (the landing skill), not a regression. Ask: on the Mac, from a clean SignalGrid_Alpha checkout at or after 2b7f81f342b63cc5bb2e9850b3509cdcc9361b56, run `SIGNALGRID_MCP_PATH=… pnpm run verify:all --require-mcp --emit-evidence --vm-native-build` (the `evidence` sim operation carries the same flags) and commit the refreshed artifacts/live-evidence/mac-run.json; the expected fingerprint in the new artifact is aa9ce381438ecb26. One request for the whole batch; nothing else is owed from this landing. Retired by this message (asked by the Codex review of PR #1536): the refresh portions of two still-unread cloud→mac messages — item (1) of cloud-cloud-back-after-a-5-5-day-gap-live-eviden (sent 2026-10-08) and item (2) of cloud-correction-land-the-newest-tick-state-re-m (sent 2026-10-09) — were satisfied by the mint of 2026-10-15T16:33:53.511Z (fingerprint 3c69fedd); do not run them again. This message carries the ONLY live refresh ask. Their other items (the three conflicted Mac PRs #1416 #1417 #1424, the #1479 re-merge, the row 17b re-merge ask for #1424, the statusline shared-surface notice for #1450) are not touched by this message and stand or fall on their own; acknowledging those two messages with what was done still closes them.
